$comment: Per-file budgets for served public assets. Measured baseline 2026-10-10 (raw/gzip bytes): islands admin-event-editor 1429/737, admin-event-text-limits 998/539, auth-status 2483/1213, avatar 287/213, copy-link 1323/714, events-calendar 5133/1991, going-count 2289/1092, join-widget 574/376 (new, ceilings 1024/512; re-measured after focus-on-load + guided-fallback behavior: 1185/593, ceilings 1536/768 = one 512B raw / 256B gzip step for the load/error/timeout handlers and the invite-fallback message, not bloat), member-profile 9471/3500 (re-measured 2026-10-12 after merging main: field-error association plus main #709 unsaved-draft warning, #722 focus and #752 progress feedback; ceiling 12288/4608 = measured x1.25 rounded up), past-events 3602/1490, rsvp-button 14498/4201, model-context 2593/1195 (new, ceilings 3584/1536), attendees-live 4494/1660 (new, ceilings 4608/1792; measured after the non-rotating fragment header, attendee-page preservation and the stale-note/focus review fixes; re-measured 4789/1811 after the same-event document admission gate, ceilings 5120/2048 = one 512B raw / 256B gzip step for the mount-key check, not bloat); styles 4749/1611 (esbuild 0.28.1 --minify from assets/); theme 11965/2776, theme-tokens 1204/330, event-theme 5688/1462, profile-theme 6528/1518, schedule-theme 3932/1197 (authored in public/, no assets/ source). The auth-status gzip ceiling uses the repository's x1.25 rule on its 2026-10-10 baseline (1213 -> 1536 B) to cover two approved fail-safe auth changes: bounded sign-out feedback and the session-read deadline when abort is ignored; raw ceiling is unchanged. Ceilings are measured size x1.25 rounded up (raw to 512B, gzip to 256B). Earlier history: minified baseline 2026-10-03 admin-event-editor 1429/737, admin-event-text-limits 998/539, auth-status 2081/1009, avatar 287/213, copy-link 1323/714, events-calendar 5133/1991, going-count 2289/1092, member-profile 6138/2414, past-events 3350/1397, rsvp-button 13662/4001, styles 4749/1611; baseline 2026-09-30 events-calendar 8108/2793, going-count 2776/1145, member-profile 5193/1977, past-events 3778/1434, styles 2087/882. Every JavaScript file under public/islands at any depth and every top-level public/*.css file must have a budget. Raising a ceiling requires an explicit decision explaining the growth; never relax a budget just to make CI green. assets/ holds the reviewed sources for islands and styles.css; public/ holds the deterministic build output for those (node ci/minify-assets.mjs --check fails on drift). Theme stylesheets are served as authored. Served behavior is unchanged: the binder suite executes the minified bytes. schedule-theme raw ceiling 5632 covers the measured clean-text merge 5444/1468 (calendar month-jump plus member-board/archive growth) with one 512B raw step; gzip ceiling is unchanged at 1536 per the auth-status precedent. 2026-10-20 reconciliation (calendar subscription help merge current main): the merge-base file is 4621B; this PR's subscription-help disclosure rules (+489B to 5110B) and main's viewer-row sticky/aria-current/forced-colors plus archive-state rules (+491B to 5112B) each fit the 5120B ceiling alone, but the combined authored file measures 5601B raw (CI identical), 481B over. The selector sets are disjoint, so no consolidation is available without changing either reviewed feature's presentation; theme stylesheets are served as authored with no minify step. Only the breached raw ceiling moves, one 512B step to 5632B (31B margin; deterministic authored bytes, so no rebuild wobble). Deliberately far below x1.25 (7168B). Gzip (1509/1536B) and every other ceiling stay fixed and fail-closed. No gate skipped or disabled.
